title: cunila lyrata
intro: Cunila lyrata, commonly known as dusty miller's mint, is a perennial herb native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, fever, and digestive disorders, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cunila lyrata include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. Bioactive constituents present in Cunila lyrata, including rosmarinic acid and ursolic acid, contribute to its therapeutic effects and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
